issue_request: FHIR-50643 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Transport. It asked to replace action-oriented Transport.code terminology with an example TransportEventCodeExample code system containing SpecimenTransport, PatientMove, and InventoryTransport, and to update the Transport code value set definition to point to the new example code system.
initial_application: PR 3665 applied the main terminology content in commit 2f07ec14e6 by replacing the old action codes with the three accepted event-code concepts and updating the ValueSet.compose system to http://hl7.org/fhir/transport-code. The application left CodeSystem.name/title as TransportCode/Transport Code and left ValueSet.description with the stale action/task wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has transport active under OO, so source/transport terminology files are in current build scope. OO 2025-09-09 minutes confirm the accepted example code system naming and event-code concept set. FHIR-50642 is a linked no-change status/business-status issue, FHIR-50912 is a separate same-PR Transport issue already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-53300 later noted related build warnings but was resolved no-change.
reconciliation: Changed source/transport/codesystem-transport-code.xml to name/title the system TransportEventCodeExample/Transport Event Code Example, and changed source/transport/valueset-transport-code.xml to describe codes identifying what the transport involves. The commit intentionally preserved the approved code literals, definitions, canonical system URL, and value set compose include.
source_changes: source/transport/codesystem-transport-code.xml: changed CodeSystem.name/title from TransportCode/Transport Code to TransportEventCodeExample/Transport Event Code Example.
source/transport/valueset-transport-code.xml: changed ValueSet.description from old action-oriented wording to event-oriented wording matching the Transport.code binding semantics.
